[[Shimmering Crystal]]s are [[crafting material]]s used to craft a new tier of guild [[Shimmering weapons]] and armor.

== Acquisition ==

{{recipe list by discipline}}

== Currency for ==
{{Vendor query table|currency=Shimmering Crystal}}

== Notes ==
* The Ore Synthesizer has a rare chance to grant 10 Crystals per harvest.
* You will need 160 Shimmering Crystals to unlock the skins for all of the weapons.
* You will need a total of 66 Shimmering Crystals or [[Tenebrous Crystal|Tenebrous Crystals]] to unlock all the guild armor skins.
{{anomaly|Players who do not have the Heart of Thorns expansion may still receive Shimmering Crystals from the synthesizer.}}

== Trivia ==

* Prior to being added to [[Gharr Leadclaw]]'s exchange, they were one of the two unique materials that could only be obtained in [[guild hall]]s.
